constraints.name: acquisition_contract_reviews_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'approved'::text) AND personally_reviewed AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND (expires_at > created_at)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (NOT personally_reviewed) AND (expires_at IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND (status = 'requires_resolution'::text) AND personally_reviewed AND (expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: acquisition_contract_reviews_note_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM note)) >= 20) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM note)) <= 4000)))

constraints.name: acquisition_contract_reviews_workspace_id_contract_id_cont_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version) REFERENCES acquisition_contract_versions(workspace_id, deal_id, version)

constraints.name: acquisition_contract_reviews_workspace_id_policy_id_kind_p_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, policy_id, kind, purpose, actor_id) REFERENCES private.acquisition_contract_review_policies(workspace_id, id, kind, purpose, reviewer_id)

constraints.name: acquisition_deadline_original_review
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, kind, deadline_term, deadline_original_review_id, deadline_original_status) REFERENCES acquisition_contract_reviews(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, kind, deadline_term, id, status)

constraints.name: acquisition_deadline_review_identity
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, kind, deadline_term, id, status)

constraints.name: acquisition_deadline_review_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'deadline_resolution'::text) AND (deadline_term IS NULL) AND (deadline_resolution IS NULL) AND (deadline_original_review_id IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'deadline_resolution'::text) AND (deadline_term IS NOT NULL) AND (deadline_term = ANY (ARRAY['effective'::text, 'inspection_deadline'::text, 'closing_deadline'::text])) AND (((status = 'approved'::text) AND (deadline_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (deadline_resolution IS NOT NULL) AND private.valid_deadline_resolution(deadline_resolution, contract_version) AND ((deadline_resolution ->> 'term'::text) = deadline_term) AND ((((deadline_resolution -> 'source'::text) ->> 'artifact_id'::text))::uuid = artifact_id) AND ((((deadline_resolution -> 'source'::text) ->> 'artifact_version'::text))::integer = source_version) AND (((deadline_resolution -> 'source'::text) ->> 'sha256'::text) = sha256)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (deadline_resolution IS NULL) AND (deadline_original_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deadline_original_review_id <> id) AND (sequence > 1))))))

constraints.name: acquisition_deadline_sources_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'deadline_resolution'::text) AND (status = 'approved'::text) AND (deadline_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(deadline_sources) = 'array'::text) AND ((jsonb_array_length(deadline_sources) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length(deadline_sources) <= 2))) OR (((kind <> 'deadline_resolution'::text) OR (status = 'withdrawn'::text)) AND (deadline_sources IS NULL))))

constraints.name: acquisition_execution_findings_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'executed_contract'::text) AND (execution_findings IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'executed_contract'::text) AND (((status = 'approved'::text) AND (execution_findings IS NOT NULL) AND private.valid_execution_findings(execution_findings, contract_version)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (execution_findings IS NULL))))))

constraints.name: acquisition_execution_sources_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'executed_contract'::text) AND (status = 'approved'::text) AND (execution_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(execution_sources) = 'array'::text) AND ((jsonb_array_length(execution_sources) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length(execution_sources) <= 13))) OR (((kind <> 'executed_contract'::text) OR (status = 'withdrawn'::text)) AND (execution_sources IS NULL))))

constraints.name: acquisition_title_execution
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, title_execution_transition_id, title_execution_status) REFERENCES acquisition_contract_transitions(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, id, recorded_status)

constraints.name: acquisition_title_findings_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'title_findings'::text) AND (title_findings IS NULL) AND (title_sources IS NULL) AND (title_execution_transition_id IS NULL) AND (title_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (title_original_status IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND (purpose = 'title_report'::text) AND (title_execution_transition_id IS NOT NULL) AND (((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (title_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (title_original_status IS NULL) AND (title_findings IS NOT NULL) AND (private.valid_title_findings(title_findings, contract_version, (status = 'approved'::text)) IS TRUE) AND (title_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (private.valid_title_source_journal(title_findings, title_sources, contract_version, artifact_id, source_version, verification_id, sha256) IS TRUE)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (title_findings IS NULL) AND (title_sources IS NULL) AND (title_original_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (title_original_review_id <> id) AND (title_original_status IS NOT NULL) AND (title_original_status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (sequence > 1))))))

constraints.name: acquisition_title_original_review
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, kind, title_original_review_id, title_original_status, title_execution_transition_id) REFERENCES acquisition_contract_reviews(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, kind, id, status, title_execution_transition_id)

constraints.name: acquisition_title_policy_snapshot_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((title_policy_snapshot IS NULL) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof(title_policy_snapshot) = 'object'::text))))

constraints.name: acquisition_title_review_identity
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, kind, id, status, title_execution_transition_id)

constraints.name: contract_review_original_artifact
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, source_version, artifact_id, purpose) REFERENCES acquisition_evidence_artifacts(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, id, purpose)

constraints.name: contract_review_original_verification
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, source_version, artifact_id, verification_id) REFERENCES acquisition_evidence_verifications(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, artifact_id, id)

constraints.name: acquisition_contract_transit_workspace_id_contract_id_con_fkey1
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, signature_review_id) REFERENCES acquisition_signature_reviews(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, id)

constraints.name: acquisition_contract_transiti_workspace_id_contract_id_con_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version) REFERENCES acquisition_contract_versions(workspace_id, deal_id, version)

constraints.name: acquisition_contract_transitions_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 20) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) <= 4000)))

constraints.name: acquisition_transition_execution_source
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, execution_review_id, execution_review_kind) REFERENCES acquisition_contract_reviews(workspace_id, contract_id, contract_version, id, kind)

constraints.name: acquisition_transition_supported_edge
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((previous_status = 'draft'::text) AND (recorded_status = 'pending_signature'::text) AND (sequence = 1) AND (signature_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_review_id IS NULL) AND (execution_review_kind IS NULL)) OR ((previous_status = 'pending_signature'::text) AND (recorded_status = 'executed'::text) AND (sequence = 2) AND (signature_review_id IS NULL) AND (execution_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_review_kind = 'executed_contract'::text) AND (execution_review_kind IS NOT NULL)) OR ((previous_status = 'executed'::text) AND (recorded_status = 'title_review'::text) AND (sequence = 3) AND (signature_review_id IS NULL) AND (execution_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (execution_review_kind = 'executed_contract'::text) AND (execution_review_kind IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: acquisition_review_policy_purpose
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = ANY (ARRAY['contract_review'::text, 'assignment_basis'::text, 'executed_contract'::text, 'deadline_resolution'::text])) AND (purpose = 'purchase_contract'::text)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['title_review'::text, 'title_findings'::text])) AND (purpose = 'title_report'::text))))

constraints.name: acquisition_title_report_policy_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((title_report_max_age_seconds IS NULL) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND ((title_report_max_age_seconds >= 1) AND (title_report_max_age_seconds <= 31536000)))) AND ((title_report_max_age_days IS NULL) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND ((title_report_max_age_days >= 0) AND (title_report_max_age_days <= 365)))) AND (((title_report_max_age_days IS NULL) AND (title_report_timezone IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND (title_report_max_age_days IS NOT NULL) AND (title_report_timezone IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title_report_timezone)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title_report_timezone)) <= 100))))))
